target: Twenty-first integer sequence term on the inverse-hyperbolic-sine scale
independent_unit: Canonical affine-normalized sixteen-term prefix family; semantic relationships not exhaustively known
timing_contract: Only first16 terms and horizon5 supplied; names, OEIS IDs and published formulas are forbidden predictors.
calibration: Sixteen observed prefix terms per sequence, including confirmation sequences; no suffix term used in rules.
scope_limits: Hash-selected finite-range OEIS reference challenge, not mathematical proof or new sequence discovery. Affine prefix aliases linked; other semantic dependence remains. Finite continuations never uniquely determine a law.
split: Canonical prefix-family hash modulo5==0 confirmation; three development hash folds
question: When can compact exact arithmetic hypotheses extrapolate a prefix, and where do they fail?
exposure: Source-aware public data. Limited schema/header and first-row previews recorded before task freeze; any inspected examples remain explicitly exposed. Confirmation performance withheld until selection and stopping freeze.
uncertainty_policy: Report per-group errors and worst-group error; no independent-row confidence intervals; one-event and finite catalogs are conditional diagnostics.
selection: Lowest development mean-group MAE, simpler model on relative1% tie. Exact mathematical algorithm baselines do not claim novel accuracy. Retain every attempt and compare named strong controls.
stopping: At least5distinct scientific attempts; continue while a justified distinct mechanism yields prediction/robustness/interpretation gain; stop after2consecutive substantive no-gain attempts after minimum5.
